visualCharacteristics: Side-by-side promotional banner on a colored (blue) background. One column holds a heading, subtext, a checkmark benefit list, and a CTA; the other holds an image. Stacks vertically on mobile, side-by-side at 900px.
contentPattern: A single row with two columns: a text column (heading, subtext, bullet list, CTA link) and an image column. Image-only columns are tagged for ordering.
usage: Promotional banners such as 'Your next Dream Vacation awaits' and partner/experience promos.
